integrity: The all-even-degree proof uses the exact Gegenbauer generating function and symbolic polynomial domination. The standalone checker verifies the complete finite geometry and selected degrees but is not used to infer an infinite theorem. Neither authorship provenance nor external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only one even homogeneous harmonic degree at a time on the 120 E8 root lines; not odd-degree, cumulative-band, perturbed-node, or independent-review assertions. Prior harmonic kernels and strongly regular geometry are credited; full text of Delsarte-Goethals-Seidel (1977) was unavailable for complete originality comparison.
title: Even-harmonic interpolation on the 120 \(E_8\) root lines: an exact rank reversal and permanent recovery
